spec.representation: within-window power spectrum SHAPE (Welch) on the reused znormed precursor cache; amplitude-invariant by construction
spec.descriptors: centroid=Sum(f*P)/Sum(P) Hz, spec_ent=normalised spectral entropy, hf_ratio=power above segment-median-freq / total; DISTINCT from Weg1 (perm_entropy, psd_slope)
spec.unit: per episode per station: PRE(-12h) vs MID (same pause), segment = mean descriptor over its 8 znormed windows
spec.primary_tests: per descriptor TWO-SIDED paired sign test + Wilcoxon on episode-wise PRE-vs-MID; MOVES if sign_p<0.05 AND wilcoxon_p<0.05; per-episode signed direction retained for consilience; UWE primary, RIMD replication
spec.amplitude_confound: neutralised by construction (znormed windows -> pure shape statistics)
spec.orthogonality_honesty: shares within-window spectral representation with Weg1 psd_slope (NOT fully orthogonal to Weg1); orthogonal to Weg2 (raw envelope dynamics); consilience shuffle-null exposes shared artifacts
